fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: MRP CODE
fields.description: MRP Code issued by CBK (e.g. Dahabshiil = 0700001)

fields.name: MRP BRANCH NAME
fields.description: The code and name of branch where the transaction took place.

fields.name: BUSINESS REPORTING DAY, MONTH & YEAR
fields.description: The reporting date, Month & Year. Format {DD- MMM-YYYY}

fields.name: CUSTOMER IDENTIFICATION DOCUMENT TYPE
fields.description: The type of identification document used.

fields.name: ID NUMBER/ PASSPORT NUMBER
fields.description: The customer's national identity card number or passport number

fields.name: SEQUENCE NUMBER
fields.description: A unique sequential number for each transaction

fields.name: CURRENCY TYPE CODE
fields.description: ISO currency codes as per ISO-4217. {e.g. USD, GPB, EUR, KES. etc.}

fields.name: TRANSACTION AMOUNT
fields.description: The transaction amount in transacting currency

fields.name: KES SPOT RATE
fields.description: The KES spot exchange rate for the business day

fields.name: COUNTRY OF ORIGIN
fields.description: ISO country code of the country where the funds originate from. {As per ISO-3166-1}.

fields.name: DESTINATION COUNTRY
fields.description: ISO country code of the country where the funds are destined. {As per ISO-3166-1}.

fields.name: SOURCE OF FUNDS OR REMITTANCE PURPOSE
fields.description: Description of the specific source of funds or the purpose for which the funds are sent or received for.
fields.payload_key: SOURCE OF FUNDS OR REMITTANCE PURPOSE
